_provenance: Declared print-appendix projection scope. Base flagship set is DERIVED at build time from catalogue-classification.json (disposition == keep-as-L2); this file declares ONLY the deviations. Consumed by book/build_book_html.py:_load_print_manifest / _flagship_slugs. Hand-authored — edit in place.
_derivation: flagship_slugs = {keep-as-L2 slugs (24)} UNION print_promotions (5) MINUS appendix_exclude = 29. appendix_exclude names a move-to-book-case entry (already outside keep-as-L2) so it is a no-op guard, not a subtraction; intro_l1_principles names the lift-to-L1 entry represented in the intro rather than as a flagship page. The 'two excludes' (standards-rule-engine to Part-5 case, semantic-level-enforcement to L1 intro) are already outside the 24 keep-as-L2, so 24 + 5 = 29.
_claude_md_rule_index_dial: The claude-md-rule-index (Governed Knowledge Base) keep-as-L2 stays a PRINT flagship by default (design 260803 §1b/§2c). The editorial dial that sends it web-only would add it to appendix_exclude, dropping print flagships from 29 to 28; NOT pulled here.
_appendix_render_modes: skill_recipe: print-render mode for the How-to-Write-a-Skill appendix (v2 Appendix D, legacy Appendix E) — 'pointer' collapses the print/PDF projection to the front-door + an online pointer, the web edition keeps the full recipe (consumed by build_book_html.py:build_skill_recipe_chapters). appendix_e: render mode for the 'A Theory of MAGE' appendix (v2 Appendix E) — 'full' renders both chapters (causal model + capability-vs-maturity); consumed by build_book_html.py:build_theory_of_mage_chapters. Both appendix E letters are v2-only (ADA_APPENDIX_V2=1).
